critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 7848 lines (phase 4 added ~400). Still well past the 700-line guideline. The phase-4 block (lines 7453-7805) is self-contained enough to extract into backend/members/treasurer.py, backend/members/agendas.py, backend/members/anniversaries.py, backend/members/referrers.py routers.

difflib SequenceMatcher is called inside a nested loop in admin_referrers (lines 7716-7729): O(N^2) over all members. Fine for N<=200 but will become slow if the club grows significantly; consider rapidfuzz if N>500.

_send_agenda_reminders iterates ALL active members per meeting and awaits each send_email sequentially (lines 7639-7644). For a 50-member club this is ~50 sequential httpx calls (~25s). Non-blocking since it's a background scheduler, but could use asyncio.gather with a semaphore for faster delivery.

member_notices.key dedupe is a soft upsert — no unique index enforced. Flagged in iteration_24 for duesrem keys; same applies to 'manniv:<uid>:<year>' and 'refnote:<year>:<round>:<rid>'. Low-risk in single-threaded scheduler.

/members/next-meeting returns ALL agenda fields including kind. Minor: the member view currently sees meeting.kind ('executive'/'general'); executive meetings are usually board-only. Consider filtering kind != 'executive' from /members/next-meeting if executive agendas should not be visible to the full membership.

AgendaIn allows blank time but no validation that location is non-empty when provided; location is .strip()[:160] which is fine. Minor UX: AgendaEditor save button on an already-published agenda labels 'Save changes' but still invokes save(false). Backend keeps status='published' because `prev.get('status') == 'published'` wins — correct behavior but worth a code comment.
AdminTreasurer calls share() both initially and from the 'Update shared copy' button (treasurer-reshare-btn) — identical handler. OK, but no toast difference between create vs. update.
